claim: IP addresses of Amazon CloudFront endpoints vary based on your end user's location and can change at any time. An Alias record lets you map your zone apex (example.com) to your CloudFront distribution, and Route 53 responds to each request for the Alias record with the IP addresses for the distribution.

evidence.quote: IP addresses associated with Amazon CloudFront endpoints vary based on your end user’s location (in order to direct the end user to the nearest CloudFront edge location) and can change at any time due to scaling up, scaling down, or software updates.

Amazon Route 53 offers a special type of record called an ‘Alias’ record that lets you map your zone apex (example.com) DNS name to your Amazon CloudFront distribution (for example, d123.cloudfront.net).
Route 53 responds to each request for an Alias record with the IP address(es) for the distribution.
